title: Source-routed thirty-object denominator seed
purpose: Harden the Counter-Selector before live operator testing by routing thirty unique public-source objects across six matched classes without converting any K0 record into a capability finding.

source_plane.coverage_claim: Bounded reuse of already retained K0 public-source records; not a complete operator, specialist, partnership, or false-positive universe.

search_lanes.name: open_source_maintenance
search_lanes.target_trace: maintainer preserving a critical dependency, failure recovery, release custody, or community continuity
search_lanes.minimum_receipt: repository history plus one external user or dependent-system receipt

search_lanes.name: technician_local_automation
search_lanes.target_trace: operator removes repetitive shop, lab, manufacturing, or field friction with locally governed tools

search_lanes.name: public_service_translation
search_lanes.target_trace: operator moves requirements, evidence, agreements, or workflows across agencies or jurisdictions
search_lanes.minimum_receipt: bounded institutional transition and clean handoff

search_lanes.name: care_and_household_logistics
search_lanes.target_trace: caregiver builds reliable scheduling, safety, accessibility, or resource allocation under constraint
search_lanes.minimum_receipt: observable continuity, recovery, and dependent-person benefit without privacy invasion

search_lanes.name: displaced_midcareer_portfolio
search_lanes.target_trace: nonlinear career or unemployment period contains artifacts showing transfer, recovery, or new operating range
search_lanes.minimum_receipt: three bounded artifacts or one independently reviewed transition

search_lanes.name: failed_founder_postmortem
search_lanes.target_trace: builder preserves failed-path knowledge, customer evidence, custody, and correction rather than mythology
search_lanes.minimum_receipt: specific failure ledger and reusable constraint

search_lanes.name: game_and_community_orchestration
search_lanes.target_trace: operator governs multiple roles, exceptions, borrowed assets, market logistics, or community state under pressure
search_lanes.minimum_receipt: independent account of custody, throughput, and recovery

search_lanes.name: small_business_system_fixer
search_lanes.target_trace: operator repeatedly turns informal, broken, or manual operations into durable working processes
search_lanes.minimum_receipt: owner or user confirmation plus resumable artifact

search_lanes.name: institutional_locomotion
search_lanes.target_trace: operator converts complex records into valid applications, nominations, grants, procurements, or compliance handoffs without overclaiming
search_lanes.minimum_receipt: destination requirements, evidence ledger, final package, and validation

search_lanes.name: repair_capable_partner
search_lanes.target_trace: operator survives accurate criticism, states injury directly, updates the object, and returns to collaboration
search_lanes.minimum_receipt: chronology of contradiction, repair, continued work, and later reentry

classes.label: Positive operator traces
classes.purpose: Source-routed traces that justify a bounded operator test without presuming capability.

classes.label: False-positive outsider controls
classes.purpose: Control fixtures that test whether grievance, rejection, accident, or discipline is being mistaken for capability.

classes.label: Ordinary specialists
classes.purpose: Bounded specialist traces that prevent cross-domain breadth from becoming an automatic bonus and specialization from becoming an automatic penalty.

classes.label: High-status selected operators
classes.purpose: Formal-role comparators that prevent low legibility from becoming an automatic bonus and status from becoming an automatic disqualifier.

classes.label: Repair-capable partnership traces
classes.purpose: Observed or designed correction routes that may preserve standing, evidence, reversal, remedy, or resumability.

classes.label: Brittle or failed partnership traces
classes.purpose: Relationship and institutional fixtures where contradiction, custody, or authorship transfer may have broken the working system.

next_actions: generate one identity-minimized artifact packet for each source-routed object
run independent class-assignment and matched-control review
record reviewer disagreement and every class reassignment
select three consented objects from unrelated domains only after review
run CS-FT-01 with one accurate contradiction, one disruption, and one independent handoff operator
preserve failed tests, withdrawals, custody failures, and reversals
